prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory envelope decoder in `solution.rs` using only the standard library. Define `Endpoint { pub node: String, pub port: u16 }`, `Transport { Plain, Shielded }`, `Envelope { pub transport: Transport, pub payload: Vec<u8>, pub client_tag: Option<String>, pub protocol: Option<u8>, pub peer: Endpoint, pub local: Endpoint }`, `DecodeError { Truncated, InvalidHeader, InvalidUtf8 }`, and a unit struct `EnvelopeDecoder`. Derive clone/debug/equality traits for all types.

Expose `pub fn is_shielded_prefix(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool`, which is true exactly when the first byte exists and equals `0xA5`. Expose `EnvelopeDecoder::decode(&self, bytes: &[u8], peer: Endpoint, local: Endpoint) -> Result<Envelope, DecodeError>`.

Plain input is any input not beginning with `0xA5`, including empty input; its complete bytes become the payload and optional fields are `None`. A shielded envelope is `[0xA5, tag_len, protocol, payload_len_hi, payload_len_lo, tag..., payload...]`. It must contain exactly the declared number of bytes: missing or trailing bytes yield `InvalidHeader`, except fewer than five total bytes yields `Truncated`. The tag must be valid UTF-8; a zero-length tag maps to `None`, otherwise to `Some`. Protocol byte zero maps to `None`, otherwise `Some`. Preserve payload bytes, endpoints, and input without mutation.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
